close_reason: Rewrote find_cert_ext doc to use 'from cert' phrasing, eliminating ambiguous 'this' referent.
description: The doc comment on find_cert_ext (lines 602-606 of pkix-path/src/lib.rs) reads: 'callers that need to distinguish parse errors from absence should call this directly and inspect the error.' The word 'this' is ambiguous — it looks like it refers to find_cert_ext itself (which swallows the error), when it actually means callers should use try_find_cert_ext instead. Replace 'call this directly' with 'call try_find_cert_ext instead' to eliminate the ambiguity.
title: find_cert_ext doc: 'this' referent is ambiguous
